summary: The milestone completed 10 experiments in 78.1 minutes, with 4 marked compute-bound. Among the reported slowest rows, the compute-bound V506 capstone and reconciliation took 24.95 minutes, the solve-versus-verify panel took 8.01 minutes, and the raw-response envelope took 5.68 minutes; the timing data do not establish the causes of those durations, and the task-conditioned GPU-idle field is false.
bottlenecks_identified: The compute-bound V506 capstone, promotion-retirement ledger, and spec/ops reconciliation was the longest recorded experiment at 24.95 minutes; no stage-level timing is available to attribute that duration more precisely.
The disk-mtime reconstruction provides experiment-level durations but no phase breakdown or GPU samples aligned to active compute-bound windows, limiting causal diagnosis and scheduling decisions.
improvements_suggested: Persist per-stage start and finish receipts for capstone assembly, promotion-retirement ledger work, and spec/ops reconciliation so the longest compute-bound path can be optimized from measured phases.
Add a dependency-aware scheduler that overlaps independent synthesis-only work with other eligible work while preserving task gates.
Record GPU utilization against active experiment windows and declare model count in the run manifest; select DualGPURunner only when at least 2 models are loaded in parallel.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument stage-level timing inside the V506-style capstone and reconciliation workflow.
Schedule dependency-independent synthesis and compute work concurrently.
Correlate GPU telemetry with active compute-bound tasks and dispatch DualGPURunner only for declared parallel-model runs.
meta_reflection: The 25% savings estimate is a conditional upper bound from fully overlapping the 19.63-minute synthesis task with dependency-compatible work: 19.63 divided by 78.1 rounds to 25%. The timing block contains no dependency graph or stage telemetry, so actual savings must be measured next milestone; the idle snapshot does not establish compute-bound GPU idleness, and runner selection cannot be graded because no concurrent multi-model run appears in the authorized data.
